pressOrOkToEdit: Press ▼ or OK to edit settings.

warn.language: ⚠ Work in progress: only English is fully translated. Any other language leaves large parts of the game untranslated.
warn.markovLlmModel: ⚠ The model runs on the processor and wants a few gigabytes of memory. It writes English, and the first line of a session waits for the model to load.
warn.asciiModeEnabled: ⚠ While ASCII mode is on it takes over the theme; switching it off gives the previous theme back.

desc.mapStreaming: Joins neighbouring procedural map squares into one seamless map. Off loads one square at a time and switches map at the border.
desc.runInBackground: Keeps the game running when its window is not focused.
desc.weatherVolume: Volume of outdoor ambient sounds: rain, storms, wind and biome sounds. Does not affect interiors.
desc.partyHud: A card per party member in the top-left: HP, MP, states and urgent needs.
desc.musicArtistDisplay: Shows the name and artist of the music currently playing.
desc.battleMusicName: Track played when a battle starts. Biome (default) uses the battle theme of the current area.
desc.battleMusicRandom: Plays a random track at the start of every battle. Hides the track selection while on.
desc.markovLlmModel: GGUF language model used to generate dialogue. Off uses Markov chains only. Place a .gguf file in the game models folder to list it here.
desc.dialogueMode: How NPCs without scripted dialogue respond. Empathize uses a Socialize action based on their personality, or a rumour. Markovian generates a new line from the NPC word bank.
desc.mapTooltips: Shows tutorial messages, compass quest targets and context tips while exploring the map.
desc.dialogueVoices: Plays a short sound for each letter of typed dialogue. Pitch depends on the speaker, and keywords are pitched higher.
desc.dialogueVoicesVolume: Volume of the dialogue letter sounds, separate from other sound effects.
desc.battleLogPosition: Screen corner where the battle log is shown.
desc.battleCommandPosition: Screen side where the battle command list, skill page and backpack are shown.
desc.lowModelDetail: Builds procedural weapons and items with fewer polygons. Improves performance on slower machines at the cost of detail.

musicArtistDisplay: First time: announced only the first time a track plays. Changing this setting resets the memory.
Every time: a cassette appears whenever a track starts. Never in battle, and never twice within five minutes.
Minimal: track and artist in the usual corner notification.
shaderStyle: Off: plain rendering with no wobble, colour banding or downsampling.
SnapVertex: PlayStation-1 look. Vertices snap to a grid, colours band and the image renders below full resolution.
Pixel Art: sprite look. Flat cel shading, large pixels and an optional limited palette.
battleLogPosition: Bottom Left: the log starts at the bottom left and grows upward.
Top Right: the log starts at the top right and grows downward.
battleCommandPosition: Left: command list, skills and backpack on the left of the screen.
Right: command list, skills and backpack on the right of the screen, away from the weapon.

resetDefaultsDone: All settings restored to their defaults
